name: AmberTools
summary: Free molecular simulation preparation and analysis toolkit; distinct from licensed Amber.

steps: Read the official AmberTools download page and distinguish free AmberTools from separately licensed Amber.
Choose either the maintainer's conda-forge AmberTools package in a new environment or the documented source build; review the current version, OS/architecture and compute-feature limits first.
For the conda route, use an isolated environment and follow the maintainer's AmberTools activation instructions; do not modify global conda channel settings on behalf of the user.
install.verify_note: Follow the official manual's basic installation checks in the selected environment; preparation, analysis and simulation tests are separate.

notes: The official conda-forge route does not provide the same CPU-parallel/GPU capabilities as other AmberTools distributions. This recipe remains guidance-only until a pinned build and smoke test are reviewed.
